digest.component_or_area: codebase-wide comment and documentation taxonomy enforcement
propositions: Six subsystems triaged 439 files in src/rebar to relocate self-referential prose (history, architecture, contracts) from inline comments to tickets, ADRs, and schema, yielding a net recovery of ~85 lines across six stacked changes.

The reconciler shard encountered load-bearing comments at event_append.py, _processors.py, and signing.py that document replay-compat and security invariants and cannot be relocated; these and other anti-refactor warnings were recorded on .joe-janitor/tools.md as do_not_move lists.

Verified-stale comments (e.g., deterministic floor range P1-P9 vs actual P1-P11, inverted CLI flags, Anthropic constraints) were corrected in place rather than deleted where they document live invariants.

Eight sites repeating a four-paragraph argument about idempotent transform order (fit-then-normalize on local side) were consolidated into proposed ADRs 0062-0069, with inline blocks reduced to one-line citations.

All six shards (reconciler, commands/CLI, llm core, plan_review/workflow, store/reducer, root/services) completed and landed as stacked changes 1542-1547 in dependency order with full test/lint/typecheck verification.
